REVIEW_DETAILS.name: Brie A.
REVIEW_DETAILS.fullStory: I'm very thankful for Brian Cline and his talented staff. After purchasing a 2 year old, certified pre-owned vehicle from a dealership, I quickly noticed that there were some issues that weren't reported or disclosed to me, resulting in my vehicle unsafe to drive and towed back to the dealership. After getting convinced by a friend that I need to find an attorney, I reached out to Cline APC with my situation. Not only did Brian and team reach out very quickly, but they took on my case with confidence. Although we were going back and forth with the manufacturer for over a year, Brian and team were incredibly responsive, thorough, and proactive throughout the entire process and in a way that felt balanced, concise, and not trying to drag out conversation to increase billable time. Additionally, they handled this case so well, I barely had to spend any brain power on case which was incredibly helpful. All this to say, we finally settled the case and won, and the settlement was significantly more than I had imagined. If you are like me and didn't want to be naive, but also didn't want to be greedy, give Brian a call, see what he can do for you. Im so, so glad I did.
